Click this button, and the downloader saves the avatar images of the users you follow.

Avatar files are saved in the `pixiv users` folder in the browser's download directory. The file name rule is `{username}_{user ID}_avatar.{ext}`, for example: `柠檬静静静静_66477791_avatar.png`.

?> How many users are crawled depends on the "How many pages to crawl" setting. Each page contains at most 24 users.
